title: Customer Tenure Wear Credit — Kestrel Advantage Balloon
content:
Long-standing Kestrel customers returning a vehicle under a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract receive a tenure wear credit against the excess wear charge. Tenure is read from the customer's completed **Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract** — one whose status is now paid in full or closed — and its contract date, the date it was signed.

| Signed before the return date | Wear credit |
|---|---|
| At least 8 years | USD 150.00 |
| At least 4 but fewer than 8 years | USD 75.00 |
| Fewer than 4 years, or no completed new-vehicle retail contract | None |

**Counting years.** Years between two dates are counted as whole calendar months divided by 12. Whole calendar months from one date to another are complete each time the later date reaches the earlier date's day of the month, so a later date that falls earlier in its month (month-end included) leaves that month incomplete. At least 8 years therefore means at least 96 whole calendar months, and at least 4 years at least 48.

## Hypothetical cases (return on 20 May of a year)

- Completed retail contract signed 20 May eight years earlier: 96 whole months, USD 150.00.
- Signed 21 May eight years earlier: 95 whole months, 7.92 years, USD 75.00.
- Signed 20 May three years earlier and still active: not completed, no tenure credit.
